name: switch
title: Switch
description: Turns a setting on or off immediately.

when: A setting that applies at once.

instead.when: The choice is submitted with a form.

guidance.rule: Name the setting by its on-state ("Online orders"), never "On/Off".

builtIn: Announced as a switch with its state; a busy state while saving.

genui.description: An on/off setting that applies at once; children name the setting by its on-state. Emits change.
